events.verdict: Pippen Jr. (MEM) steps into Schr?der's (BKN) path and initiates body contact that affects Schr?der's (BKN) SQBR at the end of the drive. The illegal contact occurs prior to Schr?der's gather and a defensive non-shooting foul is correctly called.
Schr?der (BKN) establishes himself in the court of play prior to coming into contact with the ball.
Claxton (BKN) establishes himself in Morant's (MEM) path and does not deliver any illegal contact during the pick.
Morant (MEM) moves alongside Thomas' (BKN) path and he absorbs the marginal contact as the two players come together at the end of the drive.
Johnson (BKN) dislodges the ball from LaRavia's (MEM) grasp prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Thomas (BKN) places and removes his hand from Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) side and the contact prior to the pass is marginal.
Finney-Smith (BKN) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact with Jackson Jr. (MEM) prior to the release of his pass.
Claxton (BKN) turns as he braces for the ensuing contact with Jackson Jr. (MEM), but the contact is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) legally contests Finney-Smith's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Claxton (BKN) briefly grasps and releases Edey's (MEM) jersey as the basket is scored.

Schr?der's (BKN) left hand is resting on Morant's (MEM) side when Morant gathers the ball and raises his right arm up and marginal brush contact occurs with Schr?der's hand as Morant attempts to bring two hands to the ball.
Schr?der (BKN) initiates contact to Morant's (MEM) right arm, affecting his ability to bring both hands to the ball.
Claxton (BKN) makes direct contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it from Edey's (MEM) grasp.
Johnson (BKN) makes contact with the loose ball, which is simultaneous to his contact with Edey's (MEM) right arm and the contact with Edey's arm is considered incidental.
Edey's (MEM) right foot is out of bounds when he makes contact with the ball. Possession is awarded to Memphis but should have been given to Brooklyn instead.
Finney-Smith (BKN) and Jackson Jr. (MEM) engage as the screen is set and marginal contact occurs as they disengage.
Thomas (BKN) briefly has an arm around Jackson Jr. (MEM) but he immediately releases as the pass is thrown and does not prevent him from moving freely through the lane.
Claxton (BKN) initiates contact across Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) head and arm in order to get to the ball, affecting Jackson Jr.'s ability to receive the pass.
Schr?der (BKN) raises his left arm into a legal vertical position and absorbs the contact during Morant's shot attempt.
Edey's (MEM) hand brushes Schr?der's (BKN) left arm after his gather and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Wilson (BKN) legally contests Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Claxton (BKN) establishes himself in Wells' (MEM) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Wells (MEM) cleanly deflects the ball away from Claxton (BKN) and the ensuing arm contact is incidental.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the ball does not hit the rim.
Schr?der (BKN) requests and is granted a timeout within five seconds.
LaRavia (MEM) avoids making any illegal contact with Johnson (BKN) during his jump shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) avoids making any illegal contact with Johnson (BKN) as he cleanly blocks Johnson's jump shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) cleanly blocks Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt and the shot clock expires.
Schr?der (BKN) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Morant (MEM).
Johnson (BKN) legally contests Aldama's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
